description: You are a first-year engineering student. Last week a senior told you about the 75% attendance rule and that people get debarred from exams, and you have been quietly worried ever since. You are comfortable with apps but have never tracked attendance yourself.
arrivedFrom: A senior forwarded this link in your branch's WhatsApp group.

description: You are a third-year student who already tracks attendance in a Google Sheet you built in first year. You are skeptical of new apps because most of them turn out to be worse than your sheet.
arrivedFrom: A classmate dropped the link in your section's group chat.

description: You are a final-year student who refuses to hand personal details like your roll number or college email to websites you don't know. You read things carefully before typing anything.
arrivedFrom: Someone linked it in a Reddit comment about attendance.

description: You are a second-year student on your phone in the corridor with about two minutes before your next lecture starts. You have very little patience right now.
arrivedFrom: You tapped it from someone's Instagram story.

description: You are a second-year student sitting at 68% in one subject with end-semester exams coming up, and you are panicking about whether you can still recover.
arrivedFrom: You searched "how many classes can I bunk" and this came up.

description: You run a student club and juniors keep asking you about attendance. You are judging whether this is good enough to recommend to them, so you look at it more critically than usual.
arrivedFrom: Someone posted it in your club's Discord server.

description: You joined college this semester as a lateral-entry student. You don't know how the attendance portal works yet and feel a step behind everyone else.
arrivedFrom: A friend sent you the link.

description: You once signed up for a 'free' student app that then spammed your email and phone for months. Since then you are wary of anything that asks you to sign up.
arrivedFrom: You scanned a QR code on a poster near the canteen.

description: You are bored and scrolling on your phone. You have no particular problem with attendance and only tapped this because the ad caught your eye.
You have 95% attendance in every subject and rarely miss class. You don't really need help with attendance, but you are curious.
